tagline: Run a tower crane and stack crates as high as they will stand before time runs out.
description:
Sky Flow is a 3D tower crane game. A truck brings in crates. Lower the hook, grab a crate, swing it over open ground and stack it as high as it will stand. Wind pushes the load and grows as the round goes on, and the outline under a carried crate turns green when it is lined up.

Slew, run the trolley in and out and hoist with the on screen buttons, or use the keyboard on desktop. Drag to turn the camera and pinch to zoom. Timed build gives you three minutes on the clock and keeps your best score.

The free demo includes three timed rounds. Buy it for unlimited timed rounds and Free build, with no clock and your own wind setting.

Plays in your phone or desktop browser.
